Notes of bergamot, lemon, and blackcurrant offer a bold vibrance, melting into the sweetness of praline, musks, and violet, and finishing on a dramatic base of cedar, vetiver, and warm black amber. The textured cap, inspired by Yakisugi, the Japanese art of charring wood, embodies the deep intensity, transformation, and enduring strength that mirrors the essence of the Absolu. The silver and gold atomiser spray, with its industrial edge, complements the bottle’s elemental design and the clean curves of the glass. Within the bottle, the hue of the Absolu de Parfum is intensified, offering a visual hint at the rich concentration of fragrance inside. Woody Genderless Notes: Top: Bergamot, Lemon, Black Currant Heart: Musks, Praline, Violet Base: Black Amber, Cedarwood, Vetiver How to use: To be sprayed on the skin and/or clothes.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Caban Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent's pea coat – caban in French – is known for its fascinating sophistication and its role in defining the maison's signature style. The fragrance mirrors the coat's comforting warmth and sleek lines with tonka bean, which brings notes of almond, caramel, and tobacco to the forefront. The olfaction: Inspired by YSL’s sleek, empowering pea coat, Caban reveals the innate elegance and sophistication of a simple olfactory shape, built around warm, lush tonka bean absolute. Run through with boldly woody tones, this fascinating tonka is textured with bright spices. Airy, fresh, and electric with a fruity facet, pink pepper absolute reflects light like carved golden buttons on a couture YSL caban. Tactile and sleekly sophisticated, Caban embodies a modern look with a raw yet enveloping impact. Fragrance family: Woody Spicy. Top notes: Pink Pepper Oil, Black Pepper Oil, Elemi Oil Heart notes: Olibanum Resinoid, Osmanthus Base notes: Sandalwood Oil, Tonka Bean, Patchouli Heart The inspiration: It was the very first piece Yves Saint Laurent presented under his name, in 1962. Opening his fashion show, worn with white shantung pants and mules, the thick wool double-breasted overcoat worn by sailors to ward off the cold and the rain - the caban, or pea coat – was reinvented as a couture garment. And paved the way for Yves Saint Laurent’s signature style, which borrowed from menswear to make women feel comfortable and confident. Turning the simplicity of a practical garment into the ultimate form of refinement, YSL’s caban has shown its range throughout the years, asserting a marine-inspired look or nonchalantly worn over a sleek cream satin gown. The Caban is more than just a single garment; it's a symbol of the YSL style, its clean lines and structured shape contributed to the distinctive YSL silhouette. blending masculine tailoring with feminine grace, female empowerment, and timeless sophistication. The Caban conveys a sense of confidence and power. When a person wears a Caban, they adopt a garment that historically signified authority and strength. This creates a sense of self-assuredness and boldness without compromising its fascinating elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Muse Eau de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: To draw the silhouette of his ideal, trace the iconic pieces his muses inspired, the couturier dipped his pen in the darkest of inks. Thousands of sketches embody the essence of the couturier’s aesthetics in fluid black lines. The ink blends all of his unforgettable muses, as captured through Yves Saint Laurent’s vision. The olfaction: To capture the essence of his muses, Yves Saint Laurent turned to ink. Thousands of sketches flowed from his hand, each fluid stroke revealing the inspiring silhouettes of his ideal. In those bold, black lines, he translated inspiration into tangible form, immortalising the essence of his muses and all the creativity he drew from them. Ink is the enigmatic accord chosen for Le Vestiaire des Parfums’s new fragrance: Muse. A strikingly streamlined composition crafted by Principal Perfumer Marie Salamagne: "The ink reveals enigmatic woody notes, intimate and elegant smoky facets. It veils the skin in subtle, dark, metallic tones, slightly iris-y, earthy. For me, the ink takes on the colours of creativity and mystery. It stimulates the imagination." The dusky note is etched onto a precious ingredient, Marie Salamagne compares both to paper and skin, for its softness. Carnal and supple, iris concrete offers powdery, buttery, woody and leather facets for a perfect blend. Empowered by a sensual Bourbon vanilla absolute pod – another sublime material crafted for YSL - the result is what Marie Salamagne calls "a skin scent that explodes." A fragrant tattoo with an impressive trail, as distinctive and memorable as YSL’s fascinating muses. Fragrance family: Woody Ambery. Top notes: Incense, Lavender Ourika, Clary Sage Heart Heart notes: Ink accord, Ambrette Absolute Base notes: Vanilla Bourbon Absolute, Iris Concrete and Ambery Woods Accord The inspiration: Elegant. Empowered. Androgynous. Yves Saint Laurent’s muses were like no other. Inspiring silhouettes – artists, models, actors, friends and loved ones, starting with his mother – who embodied the couturier’s style, spirit and ideal. At the heart of every Yves Saint Laurent creation lies the inspiration he drew from his muses. Their unique energy ignited Mr. Saint Laurent’s imagination and shaped his designs. More than just inspirations, they were the living embodiment of his vision. A vision that liberated the silhouette, redefined beauty, and ultimately, transformed an era. His muses were the epitome of the YSL style. They exuded a nonchalant elegance, a sense of effortless sophistication. They were often seen in simple yet impeccably tailored pieces, effortlessly donning tuxedos, embodying a chic silhouette. They were also the embodiment of the YSL spirit. They moved through the world with a captivating blend of purpose and individuality. They exuded an effortless confidence that defied convention by embracing androgyny, bold style choices.

listings.description: Escentric 01 celebrates the hyper-abstraction of Iso E Super. Escentric 01 focuses on Iso E Super at 65% of the fragrance compound in an abbreviated formula designed to maximise the molecule's efflorescence. It contains lime peel, hedione (green jasmine bud), orris incense, balsamic notes, and fresh musk, producing a seriously lingering base note. Iso E Super does not exist in nature and was created in a laboratory at the IFF in 1973. This composition echoes the mystical power of Escentric 01 in a cult-scented formula that will add a dose of olfactory intrigue to your everyday. A unisex fragrance liberated from preconceptions of identity and form. We heard the best things come in small packages. How to use: Spritz onto your pulse points, such as wrists, neck, and behind your ears, as desired, and let it dry naturally.

Layer pure and highly concentrated perfumed oils with the Eaux de Parfum to intensify its strength and richness: Apply your choice of The Alchemist Perfumed Oil first on the wrist and neck Follow with your Eau de Parfum layered on top The Acqua Profumata can be applied over the Eau de Parfum to recharge top notes and refresh the overall impression of your signature scent A recommended layer combination for A Gloaming Night perfume, designed to bring out the different facets of its enticing woody spicy scent: Like sunset falling around you, deepen A Gloaming Night Gucci perfume with Nocturnal Whisper perfumed oil. The bottle of L’Eau d’Issey Eau & Magnolia is made of 20% recycled PCR glass. Each wooden cap, made of ash, is unique in terms of its colour and its veins. listings.description: In Acqua di Parma's Zafferano, the warm and dry notes of saffron are distilled and combined with luminous notes of Italian golden fruits, like gilded sparks dancing with the intense spicy notes to create an unexpected and vibrant sensation. The woody and amber notes of tonka bean and vanilla soften the dusky accents of saffron, creating an intriguing and unexpected harmony. An exquisite experience that unfolds over time. listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Baie 19 Eau de Parfum Travel Refill, 3 x 10ml
listings.description: Truth is...Baie 19 should have been called Water 19. Not that it smells like nothing (though nothing smells like it), but it has this crisp, wet, drenched effect that water gives to the earth after the rain...And there’s a word for that, by the way: petrichor. It’s that magical feeling during heavy rain after a long dry spell, and it’s one of the most beautiful olfactive phenomena in nature. There are many reasons for this, including the ozone in the air, the negative ions, but most importantly the release of oil secretions from certain plants, accumulated after a long dry period. This is what Baie 19 is about: the dry juniper berry, the patchouli, the green leaves... all soaked by a beautiful, luminous, magnetic rain after a long drought. And the joy that comes with it... Refill your travel tube with the fragrance of your choice. Includes 3 x 10ml spray bottles.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Eau de Parfum Refillable 50ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani unveils Armani Code Eau de Parfum, a new compelling and vibrant intensity, encapsulated in the iconic Armani Code refillable bottle. A new fougère ambery spicy fragrance that opens with a faceted freshness with notes of green mandarin and unfolds into a spicy and woody heart of nutmeg essence. A masculine sensuality emerges from the fragrance’s base through a rich and warm tonka bean absolute. Armani Code Eau de Parfum opens with a fresh and vibrant green mandarin essence, sourced from Italy, which brings a distinctive tangy effect to the fragrance. This essence is obtained by grating the zest of the mandarin fruit under running water, with the essence then separated from the water. The heart of the fragrance is composed of a warm and spicy nutmeg essence. The nutmeg essence, derived from the fruit of the nutmeg trees, is obtained via a meticulous drying and steam distillation process, to create its warm, spicy, and woody note. A warm, sensual masculinity is revealed in the fragrance’s base notes, which spotlight the richness of tonka bean absolute. Creating a honeyed tobacco note with milky undertones, the tonka bean absolute is derived from the fruit of the Dipterix odorata tree. The fruits are harvested just as they fall from the tree and undergo a drying process to allow the development of the coumarin molecule, that lends tonka its scent. The absolute is then obtained using a solvent extraction method. How to use: Spray on wrists and neck. To obtain a long-lasting trail, complete by spraying in a double ring-gesture around your head and towards your shoulders.

It is the incarnation of the true Jimmy woman: glamorous, confident, playful and always full of joy. The sensual fragrance is inspired by the atmosphere when friends are getting ready to party the night away. It is not about going out; it is all about sharing the fun, the laughter and making it a girls' night in to remember. On top, a citrus note of mandarin juice contrasts with the suave, velvety peach nuances. The carnal and solar vanilla-like notes of the red spider lily blend in with the sensual vibes of jasmine sambac in the heart. The base notes of vanilla and benzoin anchor the fragrance in a deep, yet joyful way, leaving an intense vapour trail behind. For this modern floral ambery fragrance, perfumer duo Fabrice Pellegrin and Marie Salamagne have translated light into a scent for an eau de parfum as radiant as a sunrise. Sparkling top notes of organic green mandarin open the perfume with a bright and zesty start. At the heart, solar notes of orange blossom diffuse a generous sunlit aura. Addictive base notes of a pistachio wood accord blend with creamy sandalwood. For a warm and sensual fragrance with a powerful luminosity. An Eau de Parfum whose intensity is magnetic, designed by CHANEL In-House Perfumer-Creator Olivier Polge. It sparks a liberating rush each time it is applied, like love at first sight. COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU disrupts the status quo, presenting a sensual, captivating and indescribable version of femininity by means of fruity, floral and woody-ambery accords. A scent that leaves no one indifferent. COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU has taken the iconic COCO MADEMOISELLE bottle and elevated its impact and power of attraction to the next level. The scent's colour, a more intense variation of the line's hallmark pink-beige hue, evokes a deep, almost visceral sensuality. The black label accentuates the bottle's mystique. The CRUSH ABSOLU name appears in golden lettering, set into the glass like the promise of forever. Each detail strengthens the fragrance's magnetic pull and arouses fascination. To accentuate the scent's sensual nature, spray it on the pulse points: the décolleté, the nape of the neck and the wrists.

listings.rawTitle: Diptyque Orphéon Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: To mark its sixtieth anniversary, Diptyque has chosen to pay homage to the legendary encounter with Orphéon, a late-night bar at the intersection of 34 boulevard Saint-Germain and the Rue de Pontoise. The bar’s entrance was adjacent to the original Diptyque boutique, and a few years later the Maison has extended into its space. Today, the only remaining vestige from the Orphéon is the blue faceted column at the back of the Diptyque boutique at 34 boulevard Saint-Germain. Orphéon Eau de Parfum is the olfactory portrait of the place where curls of tobacco smoke mingle with powdery trails of blusher, lingering on burnished wood. At the heart of the composition is the atmosphere of that unforgettable place, recognisable through the warmth of the tonka bean, the depth of cedar and the vivacity of juniper berries.

An Amber fragrance with a strong personality, yet surprisingly fresh. Sparks of fresh and vibrant orange immediately awaken the senses. listings.rawTitle: DIOR Sauvage Extrait, 50ml

The beating heart of the composition, the precious essence of Vietnamese oud, leaves its animalic imprint with leather notes in a rich blend of noble woods. In this denser and more woody interpretation, Francis Kurkdjian, Perfume Creative Director, imagined this intense trail that pushes the limits of concentration. The dark and enveloping essence of Indonesian patchouli contrasts with the light, creamy essences of Madagascan vetiver and Virginia cedarwood. A sensual and powerful base that is contrasted by a fresh and aromatic top accord of bergamot and an essence of AOP lavender from Provence. Its bottle, with its translucent interior lacquer – a true masterpiece of glasswork – evokes a drop of deep blue ink suspended in crystalline glass, engraved with the CD monogram. A signature that also adorns the cap, like a crown on the bottle. listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu Miutine Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: The new feminine fragrance by Miu Miu - a duo of wild strawberry accord with vanilla and brown sugar twists an iconic warm floral signature with a hint of gourmand. Unconstrained and unconventionally feminine, Miutine Eau de Parfum reaffirms the essence of Miu Miu with a bold, memorable scent for those who navigate life on their own terms. Fragrance notes: Top note: Wild Strawberry accord Heart note: Gardenia accord Base note: Brown Sugar accord, Vanilla, Patchouli oil Youthful and unconstrained, Miutine offers a Miu Miu twist on an iconic fragrance family: the warm floral. Inspired by Miuccia Prada’s unconventional aesthetic, master perfumer Dominique Ropion teases the vintage genre into an effortlessly cool floral with a gourmand twist that subverts expectations. "I started from a classic and I twisted it with a surprising resonance, a harmony of mischievous freshness and opulent sensuality." Dominique Ropion, master perfumer of Miutine. Miutine Eau de Parfum is the signature Miu Miu fragrance for those who are confident in their contradictions. Featuring juicy wild strawberry to express the Miu Miu girl’s spontaneous and unyielding spirit. A radiant, milky gardenia accord to embody her effortless charm. A sweetly provocative blend of chic patchouli oil, brown sugar accord, and vanilla for her unconventional femininity. Cheeky but sophisticated. Youthful yet assertive. Irreverent and carefree. About the bottle: Twisted into a modern icon for Miutine, Miu Miu’s signature retro-modern bottle becomes more covetable than ever. Irreverent and sophisticated, with the famous matelassé glass inspired by the luxury house’s iconic leather handbags. Instantly desirable, with the Miu Miu tag as a ring around the collar. Bold and playful, with its round black cap in the shape of a sequin. The unexpected modern brown tint of the transparent glass expresses a different, ultra-contemporary type of femininity, with a touch of boyishness. Youthful as ever. But all grown up. How to use: Exude the carefree spirit of a Miu Miu girl with your new signature scent - spray Miutine to the pulse points on your neck, collarbone, and wrist. To leave an even longer-lasting scent trail, apply to the crooks of your elbows and the back of the knees, which will intensify the fragrance with the warmth of your body heat.

listings.rawTitle: HUGO BOSS BOSS Bottled Beyond Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Success is not only about pursuing personal ambitions, but also about celebrating peers. From aspirational stardom to relatable fandom, discover how BOSSes get inspired and inspire others. BOSS recognise BOSS. Bradley Cooper, Vinicius Junior, and Maluma embody this spirit of brotherhood as the three global ambassadors of BOSS Bottled Beyond. Spark admiration with BOSS Bottled Beyond, the first premium ginger-leather fragrance where opposites collide in a balanced interplay, delivering long-lasting intensity. The duality of this distinctive Eau de Parfum, echoed with the Double B monogram design, incites double the motivation, double the success. Bold. Balanced. Beyond. In this powerful dual blend, the stimulating freshness of ginger, extracted through cutting-edge technology, meets the carnal sophistication of leather. Playing on a harmonious duality of spices, ginger diffuses the scent’s pure, vibrant profile, while leather exudes sensuality. To shape this new olfactory signature, master perfumers Daphné Bugey, Frank Voelkl, and Bruno Jovanovic have brought their personal best to the collaboration. The lines are blurred between niche craftsmanship and blockbuster allure, creating a balanced, enduring trail. Reinventing an iconic design, the BOSS Bottled Beyond bottle stands out in black lacquered glass, complemented with a double-leather trim and a gunmetal-grey cap. A radiant gradient, from black to smoky grey, completes its masculine aesthetic. An engraved Double B monogram cements the fragrance’s duality. Crafted to Perform. To Go Beyond. BOSS Bottled Beyond is designed to last a lifetime. Its 50ml, 100ml, and 150ml bottles are refillable with the 200ml BOSS Bottled Beyond Eau de Parfum Refill.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Created by perfumer Olivier Pescheux, Eros Eau de Parfum expresses sensuality and power, an extreme force that represents a heroic and passionate man, much like Eros, the Greek god whose arrow can make you fall in love. A fragrance with an element of charm that brings love, passion and seduction splendidly to the fore, Eros Eau de Parfum embodies excess and provocation. It has a signature that is not afraid to flaunt itself and reveal its extremes, with a stark contrast between the extremely citrusy and the extremely delicate. Radiant and energetic top notes of Italian lemon and mandarin are paired with mint oil and a unique note of candied apple before giving way to a heart of geranium flower, clary sage essence and Ambermax. In the dry-down, Atlas and Virginia cedarwood, Haitian vetiver, Indonesian patchouli and sandalwood combine with decadent vanilla, a provocative weapon with its intoxicating and creamy effects and Amber character, to round out this Woody-Amber-Fresh Eau de Parfum. The fragrance is also produced in line with vegan principles, containing no intentionally added animal products or animal-derived products such as dairy, eggs, bee products or animal enzymes. Top notes: Italian Lemon, Mandarin, Mint Oil, Candied Apple Heart notes: Geranium Flower, Clary Sage Essence (France), Ambermax® Base notes: Cedarwood Atlas and Virginia, Vetiver Orpur Essence (Haiti), Patchouli Coeur Orpur Essence (Indonesia), Sandalwood, Vanilla

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Eau de Parfum Naturelle
listings.description: Exuding the modern scent of organic rose, Chloé Eau de Parfum Naturelle is an irresistibly floral perfume for women, connecting the strength and spontaneity of nature with that of the free-spirited Chloé girl. Effortlessly elegant, as well as authentic and aware, she lives in harmony with the natural environment she cherishes and that inspires her. This fresh and feminine Eau de Parfum for women is an eco-conscious perfume rooted in nature for wholesome luxury that resonates with the independent Chloé girl's lifestyle. Spritz on your wrists and neck to reveal a full expression of the graceful strength of nature. Vegan and formulated with 100% natural origin fragrance, the Eau de Parfum is also formulated with ethically sourced ingredients and naturally derived alcohol to envelop you in floral freshness all day long. Each gentle whisper of the emblematic and woody organic rose will remind you of a serene, natural setting that soothes and awakens the spirit. Hand-picked and ethically sourced, organic rose is the hero ingredient of this Eau de Parfum, opening the perfume with an airy and feminine aura complemented by Moroccan neroli. Fresh and delicate cedrat essence mingles with green, sparkling blackcurrant for an assertive spirit, while base notes of cedar essence add a powerful woody facet. Sensual mimosa highlights the scent's round character and elevates the floral heart notes. The eco-designed sunray-pleated glass bottle includes 25% recycled materials and comes in sustainable cardboard packaging made of 40% recycled materials. Inspired by the Maison's iconic crêpe de chine blouse with a feminine necktie, the timeless vintage-inspired bottle is adorned with a 100% recycled hand-tied ribbon in a new, natural shade of green. Refillable option only available on 100ml.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain La Petite Robe Noire Le Flacon Coeur Eau de Parfum, 20ml
listings.description: Guerlain’s iconic La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Parfum has now inspired a never-seen-before, travel-friendly, refillable bottle: the Flacon Coeur. Its travel-friendly shape makes it easy to slip into your bag and to carry around everywhere, at all times. A new creation that captures the irresistible free spirit of the most Parisian fragrances of the House. Inspired by the inimitable Parisian style, La Petite Robe Noire is an ode to freedom and love, the embodiment of elegance and style, an invitation to joie de vivre and irreverence. A characterful sillage in homage to the rose. A tailor-made rose embroidered with the finest black notes in perfumery. Combining rose essence with the tender, naturally honeyed scent of a damascena rose absolute, Guerlain has allowed a new rose to bloom. The distinctive and utterly recognisable rose that is La Petite Robe Noire's signature... Combined with almond, red berries and bergamot notes, black cherry gives La Petite Robe Noire's sillage a gourmand sophistication and an irresistible fruity accent. If the heart shape and design of this new bottle seem instantly familiar, that’s because it follows in the footsteps of another icon in Guerlain’s fragrance heritage: the famous 'inverted heart' bottle. First created in 1912 for L'Heure Bleue and then reissued for La Petite Robe Noire in 2012, this timeless bottle forms the inspiration for this part-classic, part-modern bottle and its innovative new size. How to use: The Flacon Coeur La Petite Robe Noire is an ode to freedom. Specially designed for the House’s iconic women’s scent, this 20ml size heart-shaped bottle is made to be refilled from one of the classic La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Parfum’s bottles. A new gesture, easy to adopt.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Gelsomino A Freddo Ambrosia Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by the mythical elixir of the gods, Gelsomino a Freddo Ambrosia is a fragrance crafted from the ancient technique of cold enfleurage that captures the essence of eternity - an unmistakable composition defined by its intensity and greater concentration. Rich, dense, and vibrantly alive, Gelsomino a Freddo Ambrosia is an exquisite elixir that shimmers like precious jewels, offering an enduring and elevated sillage. Its 30% pure perfume oil concentration results in the fragrance’s expressive projection and long-lasting presence. Part of the woody floral olfactive family, Gelsomino a Freddo Ambrosia opens with a radiant burst of Italian lemon notes, balanced by the warmth of olibanum nuances and the spicy allure of cardamom essences. At its heart lies the refined beauty of jasmine enfleurage extract, enriched by the deep, textured notes of black tea, orris, and myrrh, creating a harmonious interplay of light and shadow. It culminates in a powerful base, where the creamy depth of sandalwood essence meets the earthy elegance of vetiver and cedarwood notes. The composition’s starring jasmine enfleurage essence comes from a precise technique where delicate jasmine flowers are layered onto purified shea butter multiple times under the supervision of a master perfumer, ensuring every nuance of the olfactive molecule is captured, preserving the flower’s natural complexity and richness. The 50ml fragrance is housed in a transparent glass bottle, highlighting the coloured jus with a precious decorated porcelain cap and is presented in the Maison's iconic yellow hatbox. Fragrance notes: Top Notes: Cardamom, Italian Lemon, Olibanum Heart Notes: Jasmine Enfleurage Extract, Black Tea, Orris, Myrrh Base Notes: Sandalwood, Vetiver, Cedarwood, Guaiacwood

listings.rawTitle: Hermès H24 Herbes Vives Eau de Parfum Refillable 50ml
listings.description: With this third instalment in the H24 line, Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel continues her botanical exercise in the footsteps of a modern man on the move. H24 Herbes Vives Eau de Parfum recreates the sensation of rediscovering urban nature after the rain. H24 Herbes Vives Eau de Parfum combines the power of a bouquet of fresh herbs, the texture of a pear granita, and the liveliness of a high-tech molecule, Physcool®. The pure lines of the bottle designed by Philippe Mouquet are adorned with green lacquer to echo the notes of the fragrance. The box is in a deeper shade of grey-green as if traces of plant life had spread through the asphalt of the city. A lime-green line both delineates and opens up the space. The aerodynamic refillable bottle is made from 15% recycled glass. Its box is made from ECF (Elemental Chlorine Free) recycled paper pulp. H24 is the key to a new space. H for Hermès, Homme, and Hours. 24 to express a relationship with time and a link to the house’s iconic home of 24 rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré.

listings.description: Rose Milano is a haute couture unisex fragrance imagined by Giorgio Armani as a tribute to Milan, a city that is more than an emblem of fashion, it is home to the fashion of Giorgio Armani. Through this signature scent, he wanted to encapsulate his vision of the Milanese elegance, both raw and refined. Giorgio Armani reinterpreted the rose with citrusy and juicy notes of Primofiore lemon, enlightening a majestic Damascena rose, while earthy notes of a modern patchouli turn the juice into an iconic and elegant chypre accord. The new fragrance is encapsulated in the iconic Armani/ Privé squared bottle, which unveils a more modern and luminous look for the whole "Les Eaux" collection. A black shiny lacquered cap, creating contrasts between its curves and the sleekness of the squared bottle. Between modernity and timelessness, an interpretation of chypre in a new freshness, almost like the dew infused by rose petals that gives the juice an understated rosewood colour. Key notes: Damascena Rose Absolute Fragrance family: Chypre floral How to use: Apply on pulse point: wrist, inner elbow and neck.

Floral notes of frangipani, night-blooming jasmine and orris linger at the heart, while grounding vetiver, angelica root and cedarwood add warmth and sophistication. The Brightside is your passport to unforgettable memories. Infused with Baobab Oil. The Brightside has been created with AromaWellnessTM technology, scientifically proven to uplift, energise and increase positivity.
